title: Diagnostic Report: Éxito (Grupo Éxito)
summary: Éxito, Colombia's largest retailer with approximately 8.6M monthly visits, has material performance issues (Lighthouse 10/100 on homepage, 8.5 MB payload), template-based meta descriptions across all products, no structured data detected, no reviews or cross-sell on PDPs, and no editorial content engine — representing significant organic growth opportunities for a site that depends on search for 65% of its traffic.
